request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

Two point charges repel each other with a force of 100 N. One of the charges is increased by 10% and the other is reduced by 10%. The new force of repulsion at the same distance would be
(A) 100 N
(B) 121 N
(C) 99 N
(D) None of these

result.working:
By Coulomb's law, F ∝ q1·q2 at a fixed separation.
The new product of charges is (1.1 q1)(0.9 q2) = 0.99 q1 q2.
So F' = 0.99 × 100 N = 99 N.
